snippet.title: ASTARYN RPG IDLER now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Astaryn is an Idler RPG  Incremental, Dungeon Crawler.
Idle RPG with MMO-style progression. Pick a HERO, train SKILLS, fight MONSTERS, run DUNGEONS, find GEAR, join CLANS, and battle other players in the PvP ARENA.

New game on steam!
